description.value: The Tulpa lashes out with a manifestation of its caster's will. The damage type is chosen when the spell is cast.
Tether. If the Tulpa ends its turn more than 100 feet from its caster, it dissipates and the spell ends.
Multiattack (Modification). The Tulpa makes two Manifestation Strike attacks.

Harrowing Presence (Modification). When a creature starts its turn within 10 feet of the Tulpa, it must make a Wisdom saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or have the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn.
Relentless (Modification). The first time the Tulpa would be reduced to 0 hit points, it instead drops to 1 hit point. Once the Tulpa has used this trait, it can't use it again.

Unsettling Form (Modification). The Tulpa's form is partially incorporeal. It can move through objects and other creatures as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Telepathic Link (Modification). The caster can communicate telepathically with the Tulpa as long as they are both on the same plane of existence. The Tulpa can respond with simple impressions and intentions.
